svg.title: Guard and content-scan call sites
svg.desc: OutboundMcpPool runs EgressGuard, per-server governance and an awaited audit write before dispatching to an external MCP server, then scans a public server's result with ContentScan. ContentGuard, WebFetchTool and the outbound pool all call one ContentScan, which decides classification and the fail policy. TurnRunner evaluates the chain at messageReceived and beforeAgentSend through TurnGuardEvaluator.

g.text: Hover a box for what it checks and what a block does; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: COMPONENT · call sites outside the GuardChain
Three seams evaluate egress or content without the chain, and every classification goes through one ContentScan.

g.text: CONTENT SCAN · classification and its fail policy decided in one place
TURNRUNNER HOOKS · evaluated by TurnGuardEvaluator, not by a guard of their own
EgressGuard · hookPoint outboundMcpToolsCall: the per-server allow_tools list; surface_tools only controls harness-facing visibility
A throwing guard fails the call closed ("Egress denied: guard/audit failure"). egress_guard.dart, outbound_mcp_pool.dart.
governance · rate_limit.calls and token_budget.tokens, each over window_seconds, checked after the guard allows
Counters are in memory per server and published as OutboundMcpGovernanceEvent. _checkGovernance in outbound_mcp_pool.dart.
audit write · the pass entry is written before the call leaves the host, so a failed write refuses the call
Fields add server, tool, decision, principal (falls back to the caller sessionId) and credentialRef. guard_audit.dart.
dispatch · the external server answers; usage is charged before any content verdict
A budget that counted only delivered content would never bound a server whose results are blocked.
ContentScan · local and private servers and failed calls are not scanned; a null ContentScan means classification is not configured
Denials share guard EgressGuard, hook outbound_mcp_tools_call, error.code egress_denied; the reason string discriminates.
logical agent · the agent result is scanned before it returns to the main agent; a block discards a failed spawn
Order in _run: guard, output-schema validation, then the size decision. Every verdict goes through the audit logger.
search tools · the concatenated result titles and snippets are scanned before the tool returns them
A block returns "Search results blocked by content guard"; unlike the logical-agent site it writes no audit entry.
web_fetch · the converted body, capped at 50,000 characters, goes through ContentScan after the SSRF-checked fetch
It returns exactly the scanned span, so what the agent sees is what the classifier saw. web_fetch_tool.dart.
ContentGuard · adds only the hook-point gate and the enabled check over ContentScan
At the handoff it prefix-scans max_bytes and passes the whole result: the content is an agent's own output. content_guard.dart.
ContentScan · returns a verdict as data (blocked, label, failure reason, scanned span), so each site formats its own message
Empty input passes without a classifier call; exceedsCap answers the over-cap question first. Default is fail-closed. content_scan.dart.
ContentClassifier · returns safe, prompt_injection, harmful_content or exfiltration_attempt
The classifier's own provider spawn runs outside the guard chain. content_classifier.dart.
TurnRunner · the hooks are evaluated by TurnGuardEvaluator inside the turn execution loop
messageReceived runs before the turn; beforeAgentSend runs on the accumulated reply or the provider error text. turn_runner_execution_loop.dart.
TurnGuardEvaluator · a blocked message or reply becomes an assistant note and a failed TurnOutcome; with no chain the hooks are skipped
The note reads [Blocked by guard: ...] or [Response blocked by guard: ...]. turn_guard_evaluator.dart.
no shipped guard acts on these
GuardChain · evaluateMessageReceived and evaluateBeforeAgentSend run the runner's own layered chain, the one the tool hook uses
A guard added with DartclawServer.registerGuard is lost on a guards.* reload (replaceGuards swaps the whole base list).
